title: PC and SA – acquisition on 31 December N-1
text: On 31 December N-1, PC acquired 100% of the shares of SA for 820. The individual balance sheets at the acquisition date are given below.
At the acquisition date, the fair value of SA's equipment is 330. In addition, a brand that SA developed internally and never recognised is identified; its fair value is estimated at 280.

title: PC acquires 75% of SA
text: On 31 December N, the parent company PC acquired 75% of the shares of SA for 210. The individual balance sheets at the acquisition date are given below. No information on fair values is available.

title: Company Torvik – acquisition of a machine
text: – The machine is delivered on 1 July N and ready for use on the same day.
– Purchase price excluding VAT: 742,000, payable in full on 1 July N+1.
– Training of Torvik's operators by the machine supplier: 30,000.
– The machine is used to launch a new product; on 1 July N Torvik spends 50,000 on advertising the product.
– Technical useful life: 15 years. Torvik's policy is to keep no machine for more than 8 years; the resale price after 8 years is estimated at 110,000 (zero after 15 years).
– Torvik's borrowing rate is 6%. Depreciation is straight-line.
All costs other than the purchase price are paid in cash on 1 July N.

title: Company Torvik – land for own use
text: On 1 January N Torvik acquired land for 6,400,000 for its own use (it will build a warehouse on it). The fair value of the land is estimated at 6,750,000 on 31 December N and at 6,520,000 on 31 December N+1.
